clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's anxiety rising as she lay awake over money in March 1988, her move to distance from your father over money by May 1988, your brother's grades falling by November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts pile up across a year and a half, with the death sitting among them and your mother's anxiety settling after she returned to work.
